_comment: QGS — Mafia 2 Online (M2O V2) dedicated server. Built against the MafiaHub Framework server integration.
name: Mafia 2 Online
author: support@qgshosting.com
description:
Mafia 2 Online (M2O V2) — the multiplayer modification for Mafia II.

Requires glibc 2.38 or newer, so the image must be Ubuntu 24.04+ or Debian 13+; on older bases the binary refuses to start with missing GLIBC_2.38 symbols.

Two ports are needed: UDP on the game port for all traffic, and a TCP port for the small HTTP endpoint the in-game server browser and the MafiaHub masterlist read. Give the server a second allocation and set API_PORT to it — the server does not derive that port from the game port, it defaults to 27016 regardless.

M2O_DOWNLOAD_URL defaults to the QGS mirror of the build archive; point it at another URL to pin a different version, or leave it empty and upload M2OServer, libnode.so.141 and crashpad_handler through the file manager.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Mafia 2 Online (M2O V2) dedicated server — QGS installer
#
# The V2 build is not published at a stable public URL; it ships through the
# project's Discord as M2O-<version>.zip, with the Linux binaries under
# server-linux/. Set M2O_DOWNLOAD_URL (admin-only) to a direct link to that
# archive and the install pulls it automatically. Left empty, the install still
# prepares the layout and server.json so the three binaries can be uploaded
# through the file manager.

set -u

apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq curl unzip tar file ca-certificates > /dev/null

mkdir -p /mnt/server/resources
cd /mnt/server || exit 1

if [ -n "${M2O_DOWNLOAD_URL:-}" ]; then
    echo "Downloading the build archive..."
    if ! curl -fsSL -o /mnt/server/.m2o-build "${M2O_DOWNLOAD_URL}"; then
        echo "ERROR: download failed. Check M2O_DOWNLOAD_URL."
        exit 1
    fi

    ARCHIVE_TYPE="$(file -b --mime-type /mnt/server/.m2o-build)"
    echo "Archive type: ${ARCHIVE_TYPE}"

    if [ "${ARCHIVE_TYPE}" = "application/zip" ]; then
        if unzip -l /mnt/server/.m2o-build | grep -q 'server-linux/'; then
            # Extract into a staging directory and move server-linux/ up, keeping the
            # tree intact. The docs suggest "unzip -j", but the archive also ships
            # resources/<name>/{client,server}/... and junking paths collapses those
            # into the server root, where the identical file names overwrite each other.
            rm -rf /mnt/server/.m2o-extract
            unzip -q -o /mnt/server/.m2o-build '*server-linux/*' -d /mnt/server/.m2o-extract
            SRC="$(find /mnt/server/.m2o-extract -type d -name server-linux | head -n 1)"
            if [ -z "${SRC}" ]; then
                echo "ERROR: no server-linux/ directory inside the archive."
                exit 1
            fi
            cp -a "${SRC}/." /mnt/server/
            rm -rf /mnt/server/.m2o-extract
        else
            unzip -q -o /mnt/server/.m2o-build -d /mnt/server
        fi
    elif ! tar -xf /mnt/server/.m2o-build -C /mnt/server; then
        echo "ERROR: the file is neither a zip nor a tar archive."
        exit 1
    fi

    rm -f /mnt/server/.m2o-build
else
    echo "M2O_DOWNLOAD_URL is empty, skipping the download."
    echo "Upload M2OServer, libnode.so.141 and crashpad_handler into the server root."
fi

# A zip transfer does not preserve the executable bit.
[ -f /mnt/server/M2OServer ] && chmod +x /mnt/server/M2OServer
[ -f /mnt/server/crashpad_handler ] && chmod +x /mnt/server/crashpad_handler

# The server writes a full default server.json when none exists. Seeding it here
# means the very first boot already binds the allocated port instead of 27015.
if [ ! -f /mnt/server/server.json ]; then
    cat > /mnt/server/server.json <<EOF
{
    "host": "0.0.0.0",
    "port": ${SERVER_PORT},
    "apihost": "0.0.0.0",
    "apiport": ${API_PORT},
    "map": "${MAP_NAME}",
    "maxplayers": ${MAX_PLAYERS},
    "password": "${SERVER_PASSWORD}",
    "server-token": "${SERVER_TOKEN}",
    "mod": {
        "season": "${SEASON}",
        "map_file": ""
    }
}
EOF
    echo "Wrote server.json"
fi

if [ ! -f /mnt/server/M2OServer ]; then
    echo ""
    echo "NOTE: M2OServer is not present yet. The server will not start until it,"
    echo "      libnode.so.141 and crashpad_handler are in the server root."
fi

echo "Install finished."

variables.name: Build archive URL
variables.description: Direct link to the build archive (M2O-<version>.zip, or a tarball holding the same files). Defaults to the QGS mirror; point it elsewhere to pin another version. Left empty, the binaries have to be uploaded by hand. Admin only.

variables.name: API port
variables.description: TCP port for the HTTP info endpoint the in-game server browser and the MafiaHub masterlist read. Must be a second allocation on this server — it is not derived from the game port.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: Connection cap reported to the browser and enforced on join.

variables.name: Season
variables.description: World season. Validated at boot — anything other than summer or winter stops the server with an error.

variables.name: Map name
variables.description: Map name shown in the server browser.

variables.name: Server password
variables.description: Password players must give to join. Empty lets anyone in.

variables.name: Masterlist token
variables.description: MafiaHub push token. Without it the server still runs, it just is not announced in the in-game browser.

variables.name: Library path
variables.description: Lets the loader find libnode.so.141 next to the executable. Do not change.

variables.name: Disable Tracy invariant check
variables.description: Without this the embedded profiler aborts the server on startup on CPUs with no invariant TSC, with exit code 1 and no message. Do not change.
